outcome: Maternal need for intensive care unit
cohort: Singleton pregnant women who gave birth at a tertiary hospital in Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan province, Iran, between January 2020 and January 2022
finding: Iron-deficiency anemia during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage, maternal blood transfusion, preterm birth, low birth weight, intrauterine growth retardation, and neonatal intensive care admission.
mod_finding: Iron-deficiency anemic mothers had substantially more instrumental deliveries than non-iron-deficiency anemic mothers (4.3% vs. 0.8%), while the incidence of cesarean section was lower.
